name: Frame-by-Frame Animation
visualIdentity: Hand-drawn character animation from individually drawn frames with consistent proportions and intentional line variation. Key drawings, in-betweens, and exposure holds are planned in advance. Animation on twos at 24 fps uses 12 distinct drawings per second. This is a supplemental reference; the source does not name it as a direct style.
suitableUses: Explicit: character performance shots, and held dialogue, title-card, or reaction beats when paired with line-boil variants. Explicit: interactive HTML with play, pause, and frame-step controls. Suggested with watercolor backgrounds: poetic shorts and picture-book adaptations.
limitations: Moving one image or adding random jitter does not count as frame-by-frame drawing. Output frame rate is not drawing rate. Rough.js does not animate or create poses, and hachure fills are not authentic pencil or print. Simulated appearance is not photographed production. Remotion is used only under its documented fallback condition.
palette: Example palette, reference-dependent and optional. Tokens: background #F5EEDC, foreground #303C44, accent_1 #72929A, accent_2 #BF7C65. Foreground on background measures 9.78:1. Accents measure about 3.39:1 against foreground, so they are decorative fills only. Approved exact colors override these tokens, and gradients are disabled.
motionAndInteraction: Poses render at the planned exposure cadence without invented interpolated poses. Delivery frame rate may exceed exposure rate. Preserve stepped exposure, whole-pixel placement, and line-boil cadence. Derive state from composition time and verify direct, backward, and out-of-order seeks. Live input applies only to interactive output, never to video export.
audio: The source sets no mandatory audio. Music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence are task-specific suggestions, and user-supplied audio takes priority. Base choices on topic, mood, and motion cadence, and avoid competing with narration. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, absence of clipping, and picture synchronization.
assetRequirements: No assets are supplied in this source. Drawn frames must be produced independently or redrawn at each drawing interval. Layers or numbered sequences need alpha transparency, consistent dimensions, clear naming, and a layer manifest. Inspect assets and fonts before composition, and report any missing assets. Any Rough.js contours must use cached, fixed seeds.
combinations: Use alone for character performance shots. With style-037 watercolor plates, washes stay within the reference palette, plates never boil, and character line stays separate. With style-092 line boil, use two or three aligned variants only during holds, on one cadence, never on action drawings. Optional motion-006 gaze tracking requires eye layers or a suitable rig.
productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the primary drawing tool; PixiJS, p5.js, and Rough.js are optional renderers. A paused GSAP timeline owns motion timing, with one owner per animated property. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for check, snapshot, and render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or verifiably blocked, and the reason must be recorded. Verify decoded opening, action, transition, and closing frames.
